οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐλύμποιο: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus; gen. sg., epic Οὐ- lengthening and genitive in -οιο (= Attic Ὀλύμπου)
οὐτάμενοί: οὐτάω — wound, stab; aor. part. mid./pass. masc. nom. pl., athematic: ’wounded’; accented before the enclitic τε
οὔτέ: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj., accented οὔτέ before an enclitic
οὔτασται: οὐτάω — wound, stab; perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’has been wounded’
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
οὗτός: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: ’this man’ · also masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τις: οὗτός τις … ἀνήρ ’this is some man’
πάθον: πάσχω — suffer, experience; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπαθον); the form also serves 3 pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ)
πάτροκλε: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. voc. sg.
πάτροκλος: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. nom. sg.
πέρσας: πέρθω — sack, destroy; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having sacked’
πέτρης: πέτρη — rock, cliff; fem. gen. sg.
παλάμῃσι: παλάμη — palm, hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, come up to (+ dat.); impf. 3 sg.: ’stood by’
πατρόκλεες: Πατροκλῆς, Πάτροκλος — Patroclus; masc. voc. sg., epic voc. Πατρόκλεες
πείθεο: πείθω — persuade; mid. πείθομαι obey (+ dat.); pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic -εο (= Attic πείθου)
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ), agreeing with δίφρον · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with δειρήν: ’very beautiful’ · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with τεύχεα: ’very beautiful (armour)’
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πηλεύς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
πηλεὺς: Πηλεύς — Peleus, king of the Myrmidons, father of Achilles; masc. nom. sg.
πηλῆος: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ποδάρκης: ποδάρκης — swift-footed; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Achilles · also Ποδάρκης — Podarces, son of Iphiclus, leader of the men of Phylace; masc. nom. sg., proper name
ποιμένι: ποιμήν — shepherd; masc. dat. sg., in the standing royal title ποιμὴν λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολέμῳ: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. dat. sg.
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί; as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also prep. + dat.: ’at, by’ (ποτὶ γούνασι ’at the knees’) · also prep. + acc., ’against, up to’ (ποτὶ δ’ αὐτὸν τεῖχος ἔδειμαν ’built a wall against it’) · also adv., ’besides’, hardly to be translated (ποτὶ βρόμος ’the roar besides’)
πού: πού — somewhere; enclitic adv., weakened to ’I suppose, surely’
προσέφη: πρόσφημι — speak to, address; aor. 3 sg.
προσηύδα: προσαυδάω — speak to, address; impf. 3 sg.
προτὶ: πρός (epic προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρόες: προΐημι — send forth, give up; aor. imper. 2 sg.: ’give up!’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρὸς: πρός — towards, to; prep. + acc. · also + gen.: ’from, at the hands of’ (πρὸς Τρώων ’from the Trojans’) · also + gen. of witnesses: ’before, in the sight of’ (πρὸς θεῶν ’before the gods’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (πρὸς … ἔειπεν ’addressed’) · also adv., ’besides’ (πρὸς δ’ … ῥῆξε ’and besides … broke’) · also prep. + dat.: ’on, against’ (πρὸς χρυσῇ περόνῃ ’on a golden brooch’) · also + gen. of direction: ’toward, on the side of’ (πρὸς ἁλός ’toward the sea’) · also in πρὸς ἰθύ ’straight toward’, with ἰθύ adverbial
πτερόεντα: πτερόεις — winged (πτερόν ’feather, wing’); neut. acc. pl.: ’winged (words)’ · also masc. acc. sg., of an arrow: ’winged’
πτόλεμός: πτόλεμος — war (epic by-form of πόλεμος); masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
πω: πω — yet, up to now; enclitic adv., usually with a negative
πως: πώς — somehow, in any way; enclitic adv. (οὔ πως ’in no way’)
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect · also acc. pl., direct object: ’feet’ (πόδας καὶ χεῖρας ’feet and hands’) · also acc. pl. after ἐπί: ’on (both) feet’ (ἐπ’ ἀμφοτέρους πόδας ’on both feet’)
πόσις: πόσις — husband, spouse; masc. nom. sg. · also πόσις — drink; fem. nom. sg. (βρῶσίς τε πόσις τε ’food and drink’)
πότνια: πότνια — lady, mistress, revered; fem. nom. sg., title of a goddess or queen · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’lady’
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’) · also prep. + gen., ’by, beside’ (πὰρ ποταμοῖο ’by the river’) · also prep. + acc., ’beyond’ (πὰρ δύναμιν ’beyond one’s power’)
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’
πᾶσα: πᾶς — all, whole; fem. nom. sg., with χθών · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with ἔπαλξις: ’the whole (of it)’ · also fem. nom. sg., agreeing with Ἴλιος: ’all (of Ilios)’
σευ: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic enclitic (= Attic σοῦ): ’your, of you’
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
στενάχων: στενάχω — groan, sigh; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
στρατὸν: στρατός — army, host; masc. acc. sg.
σύ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., accented before the enclitic πέρ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic γε: εἰ δὲ σύ γ’ ’but if you’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic ἐσσι: τίς δὲ σύ ἐσσι ’who are you?’ · also nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε (elided τ’): ’you’ (σύ τ’ ἐϋφρήνῃς ’that you may gladden’)
σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (gifts)’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τέλος: τέλος — end, fulfilment, outcome; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., as object (τέλος πολέμοιο κιχείω ’I find the end of the war’) · also neut. acc. sg. with the -δε of direction (τέλος δέ ’to the end’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐς, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐς … τέλος ’to the company’) · also neut. acc. sg. after ἐπί, a body of men: ’company’ (ἐπὶ … τέλος)
τέρεν: τέρην — tender, delicate; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δάκρυ: ’(a) tender (tear)’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’)
τίκτε: τίκτω — bear, beget; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἔτικτε): ’bore, begot’ (of mother or father)
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τειρόμενοι: τείρω — wear out, distress; pres. part. pass. masc. nom. pl.: ’being worn down’
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, esteem; fem. acc. sg. · also requital, satisfaction for a wrong: ’redress’
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with τιμήν: ’whatever’ (ἥν τιν’ ἔοικεν ’whatever is fitting’)
τινά: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., indefinite, accented before an enclitic: ’a (man)’ · also masc. acc. sg. with a negative: ’no one’ (οὔ τινά φημι ’I say no one’) · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with μῆτιν: ’some’
τινα: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., indefinite: ’whatever one’ · also masc./fem. acc. sg. ’someone, some’; after a relative, ὅν τινα, ἥν τινα (= ὅντινα, ἥντινα), part of ὅστις: ’what, whatever’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’ · also masc. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους ’the others’) · also masc. acc. pl. in the correlative τοὺς μέν … τοὺς δέ: ’some … others’
τοῖον: τοῖος — such, of such a kind; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’such a one’ · also neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’such (a thing)’, alone or correlative with οἷον (τοῖον … οἷον ’such … as’)
τροίης: Τροίη — Troy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic Τροίας)
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρῶας: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τυδεΐδεω: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus (patronymic of Diomedes); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’)
τόδ: ὅδε — this (near the speaker); neut. acc. sg., elided (τόδ’ = τόδε) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a noun: ’this’ (τόδ’ αἰνὸν ἄχος ’this dread grief’)
τύνη: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg., epic emphatic τύνη (= Attic σύ)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φασὶ: φημί — say, assert; pres. 3 pl.: ’they say’
φεύγοντες: φεύγω — flee; pres. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’fleeing’
φθίης: Φθίη — Phthia, the land of Peleus; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
φιλεῖ: φιλέω — love, hold dear; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’loves’
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φόως: φῶς (φάος) — light; neut. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic φῶς) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’light’; figurative ’deliverance, safety’
φύγοι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., of wish: ’may he escape’ · also in an indirect question: ’how he might escape’ (ὅπῃ φύγοι ’how he might escape’)
χέει: χέω — pour, shed, scatter; pres. 3 sg. act., uncontracted (= Attic χεῖ)
χέων: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’shedding (tears)’
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’ · also fem. gen. pl. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hands’ (θρασειάων ἀπὸ χειρῶν ’from the bold hands’)
χόλος: χόλος — anger, wrath; masc. nom. sg.
χώρης: χώρη — place, spot; fem. gen. sg., Ionic (= Attic χώρας)
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγγελίην: ἀγγελίη — message, news; fem. acc. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’) · also neut. nom. pl., in apposition (ἀγλαὰ τέκνα ’splendid children’)
ἀεικέα: ἀεικής — unseemly, shameful, unfitting; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. pl. · also fem. acc. sg. (adj. of two endings), agreeing with λώβην: ’unseemly (insult)’
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀκμῆτες: ἀκμής — unwearied, fresh (the opposite of κεκμηώς); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl.
ἀλαλητῷ: ἀλαλητός — war-cry, shout; masc. dat. sg., of manner: ’with a shout’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμύνων: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’defending’
ἀμύνῃς: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. subj. 2 sg., in a purpose clause after ἵνα
ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act.; ἀπὸ … ἀμῦναι ’ward off from’
ἀνάπνευσις: ἀνάπνευσις — breathing-space, relief, respite; fem. nom. sg.
ἀναπνεύσωσι: ἀναπνέω — get breath again, recover; aor. subj. 3 pl. act.: ’may get breath’
ἀνδροφόνοιο: ἀνδροφόνος — man-slaying; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., paired with ἐποτρύνει: ’bids’

ὠκὺς: ὠκύς — swift; masc. nom. sg.; πόδας ὠκύς ’swift in feet’
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’) · also correlative with ὣς: ’as surely as’ (ὣς … ὡς, in a wish like an oath) · also adverb, demonstrative: ’so, in that way’ (ὡς ἂν … οὐκ ἐθέλοιμι ’so I would not wish’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὤμοιιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dual gen., epic -οιιν (= Attic ὤμοιν): ’from the shoulders’ · also masc. dual dat., of place with εἱμένος: ’about the shoulders’ (ὤμοιιν νεφέλην ’a cloud about the shoulders’)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦχ: ὦκα — swiftly, quickly; adv., elided and aspirated (ὦχ’ before a rough breathing)
ὧς: ὥς — thus, so; adv. (printed ὧς, = ὣς; Attic οὕτως)
ῥεῖα: ῥεῖα — easily, lightly; adv. (= Attic ῥᾳδίως)
ῥηγμῖνι: ῥηγμίς — the line of breaking surf, the beach at the waterline (ῥήγνυμι ’break’); fem. dat. sg.
